household_return_source.source: Orion client-keyed performance table fact_performance, newest date partition (the client's index-level series; no figure recorded, no return filled)
household_return_source.words: The household return is NOT filled: contract 0.4.3 sources every household-grain return ABSENT and its read rule forbids a figure from a source it does not name (surprise row IRPT_DASHBD-D2-W173-S1). Measured for the issuer: the client series holds the anchor day of qtd, ytd and last_12_months and the as_of day, so all four windows would open if a contract sourced them. The index level would be read as the level on the window's last day over its level on the anchor day, minus one; that is not computed here. Account first data dates: the earliest transDate of the account in the newest fact_transactions partition, which holds the full history (four of five accounts); for the one account with no transaction there, the earliest createdDate of its fact_positions rows (one of five). Account window statuses: NOT_SPANNED where the first data date is after the window's trading-day anchor, else BREAK, because no account return row exists yet (surprise row S2). Asset classes: not mapped; Opal's seven-class placement needs a classification table outside this grant (surprise row S3), so hold.allocation is absent with NO_SOURCE_YET for every class.
